question: Should OpenClaw core accept `sessions.diagnose` as a supported Gateway RPC, CLI command, Swift model surface, and result vocabulary in this PR?
rationale: The code review did not find a mechanical defect, but only maintainers can commit OpenClaw to a new durable public operator/client API surface and decide whether the current vocabulary is the right long-term shape.

options.title: Accept Current Diagnose Contract
options.body: A maintainer explicitly accepts the read-only RPC, CLI behavior, Swift model, and result vocabulary as supported operator/client surface before merge.

options.title: Narrow The Contract First
options.body: Trim result fields, finding codes, or CLI behavior before landing if maintainers want less compatibility surface.

options.title: Pause Or Defer Direction
options.body: Hold or close this PR if core should not own a public diagnosis API yet and the work should continue in the linked feature discussion.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Diagnose Contract
recommendation.body: A maintainer explicitly accepts the read-only RPC, CLI behavior, Swift model, and result vocabulary as supported operator/client surface before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across Gateway/session/protocol-adjacent areas and is a plausible owner for accepting or narrowing the public API shape.
